label: extension experiment, pre-registered (2026-10-21; signed off with amendments 2026-10-22)

P-E4.1.criterion: median step time (after the anchor) increases strictly with W: 0.25 < 0.5 < 1 < 2 < 5 s, 12/12 flights

P-E4.2.criterion: median <= 33 ms at W = 0.25 s and > 33 ms at W >= 1 s, 12/12 at each (both median readings, D13)

convergence.rule: D12: flag iff any of the four RMS readings > 0.029 m

H-E4.3.criterion: live RMSE at W = 5 s < live RMSE at W = 0.25 s, same flight, >= 10/12 (>= 10/12: judgement, not derived from data)

gain_fraction.definition: f_i(W) = (L_i(0.25) - L_i(W)) / (L_i(0.25) - B_i); F(W) pooled sums; DESCRIPTIVE
